error.message: Nothing was posted. ComplyEaze Bridge could not tell whether a Microsoft Store app's package on this computer, such as <desktop client> Desktop installed from the Microsoft Store, keeps an import journal of its own, because Windows did not answer for the folders it checks. Neither copy's checks would see the other's batches, so it refuses rather than risk posting a row twice. Restart this computer and post again. If it is refused again, stop posting on this computer and keep the batch. Do not move or delete either folder.
error.next_step: Nothing was written or posted. On this computer Windows keeps a second copy of ComplyEaze Bridge's data folder inside a Microsoft Store app's package, as it does for <desktop client> Desktop installed from the Microsoft Store, and that copy holds an import journal other than this process's. The journal checks of one copy do not see the batches of the other, so a row posted from one could be posted again from the other. The cause says what was found. With other_journal_holds_batches or other_journal_not_read, tell the user to post from the copy that already keeps that journal (the extension inside <desktop client> Desktop, when the package is <desktop client> Desktop's), not from this one. Batches this copy already built or posted are not seen by that copy, so a row posted from here could be posted again from there; check such a row in Tally before posting it there. With package_copies_not_listed, journal_not_located or package_copy_journal_not_located, ComplyEaze Bridge could not tell whether there is a second journal, so no other copy is known to post from: tell the user to restart the computer and try once more, and if it is refused again to stop posting on this computer. Either way, tell the user not to move, merge or delete either folder. Uninstalling, resetting or repairing that Microsoft Store app removes its copy and the journal in it. Running bridge_mcp --local-data-report --show-paths outside <desktop client> Desktop lists the package copies (package_copies). Apart from that one try, do not retry here.
